label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: NZ Topo switches to finer tiles one zoom level later: tile zoom = round(camera zoom + 1), was + 2 (TOPO_TARGET_PX 256, was 128). Camera zoom 16 still reaches z17.

Hut and other new names appear while moving: a grown label atlas (up to 4 MiB) uploads during gestures, and any atlas waits at most 200 ms while moving (previously its predicted cost never fitted a gesture frame, so it waited until the map was still). The atlas starts at 2048x256, so it grows less often.
Names no longer vanish when the atlas grows: the renderer keeps drawing the placed names from the previous atlas until the new placement is built.

Names from a finer or coarser source tile are the same label: label keys use layer, text and a ~10 m grid (were feature id and exact point), and renderer fade-in/height continuity matches points within ~10 m, so names keep their place and do not fade in again while zooming.
Compact route bar 116 dp (was 136): tighter grip, stats and tool buttons.
Choose region: 'Custom' page size; corners then resize the frame freely. Live area readout in km.
Download region is a bottom panel like the route bar (was a dialog), with the area size. 'Included imagery' moved under Advanced with the region coordinates.
